candidates.title: How Sachin Pilot's Report Led To Amarinder Warring's Exit As Punjab Congress Chief
candidates.excerpt: Former minister Vijay Inder Singla is seen as the frontrunner, with Jalandhar Cantonment MLA Pargat Singh and Gurdaspur MP Sukhjinder Singh Randhawa also in the race.

candidates.title: Ongole Utsavam Celebrates 150 Years of the City’s Journey
candidates.excerpt: Former vice president M. Venkaiah Naidu, the chief guest, recalled his long association with Ongole, saying the city played a significant role in his political journey, which began from the Ongole Lok Sabha constituency in 1977.

candidates.title: Congress-CPM Student Youth Wings Clash in Kerala Capital
candidates.excerpt: The Youth Congress had organised a march demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

candidates.title: Former Gujarat Chief Minister Shankarsinh Vaghela Likely To Rejoin Congress
candidates.excerpt: The state unit of the Gujarat Congress has already given its go-ahead for his return, and a final approval is pending with the party's central command.

candidates.title: FlyDubai scare: 'Crash' attempt, pilot stabbing and a 17,000-ft plunge | What we know so far
candidates.excerpt: For now, flydubai has confirmed the cockpit altercation and safe emergency landing, while the more serious allegations about an attempted crash and the motive remain under investigation.

candidates.title: RR Collectorate Busts Spurious Fertiliser Units
candidates.excerpt: Two units manufacturing and storing counterfeit fertilisers were busted in Ranga Reddy, with MOP, DAP and complex fertilisers seized and three arrested.
